data.desc: Tiptree Inc. (NASDAQ: TIPT) is an insurance holding company focused on building and growing P&C insurance businesses in specialized markets. The Company's strategy combines experienced management teams, disciplined underwriting and prudent investment and capital management to create long-term shareholder value. Tiptree seeks to build businesses distinguished by underwriting expertise, strong distribution relationships and sustainable profitability, with the objective of compounding book value per share over time.
